sloka: स तु राज्यं चिरं कृत्वा वानराणां हरीश्वरः ।स च ऋक्षरजा नाम कालधर्मेण सङ्गतः ।। ७.३६.३८ ॥
transliteration: sa tu rājyaṁ ciraṁ kṛtvā vānarāṇāṁ harīśvaraḥ ।sa ca ṛkṣarajā nāma kāladharmeṇa saṅgataḥ ।। 7.36.38 ॥

translations.english: Having ruled the kingdom of monkeys for a long time as their lord, Ṛkṣarajas eventually succumbed to the law of time.
